content: Our final loss function includes, in addition to an optional projection loss, masked language modeling cross-entropy losses for the student as well as the teacher models, since the teacher model is trained with dual-vocabulary inputs and is not static. $P(y_i=c|\theta _{s})$ and $P(y_i=c|\theta _{t})$ denote the student and teacher model prediction probabilities for class c respectively, and $\mathbb {1}$ denotes an indicator function. Equations DISPLAY_FORM10 and below define the final loss $L_{final}$, where $\epsilon $ is a hyperparameter.
